views.markdown:
- Add a configurable flashlight timeout, defaulting to 180 seconds.
- Cancel pending timeout on manual shutdown and restart on activation.
- Support direct AVFoundation flashlight control used by RemoteCompanion.
- Hook the concrete iOS 17 capture-device class used by RemoteCompanion.
- Retain the capture device until the pending timeout completes.
- Release the retained device immediately when the tweak is disabled.
